notes: Model pilot (sonnet arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L5/N9830- (zeroing this neuron removes 0.85 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Sonnet 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes fired 0.5-0.9 across English, code and French, and meaning-only paraphrases (drive, canvassing, offensive) stayed near 0, so it is lexical. Champagne scored exactly 0.3, kept as the one hard-edge near miss.
